newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.47 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Thursday's tender was 4.47 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compared with the average accepted yield of the previous 28-day bills tender of 4.50 percent on January 28.
The HK$5 billion issue was oversubscribed at HK$16.33 billion, compared to total bids of HK$12.80 billion on Tuesday, it said.
The average tender yield was 4.50 percent.
